detailed_description:
The target video is a soft, romantic cinematic close-up with warm golden-hour backlight, shallow depth of field, and a gentle film grain; the room dissolves into soft golden bokeh behind the couple while their faces remain sharp.
[Shot 1] A tight close-up frames the couple in three-quarter profile, their faces only a few centimeters apart. <Subject 2>, the young man in the navy overcoat and grey fringed scarf, looks down at <Subject 1>, the young woman in the white lace blouse, red hair tie, and round brown glasses, her head tilted slightly up toward him. Warm light from the floor-to-ceiling windows of <Subject 3> rims their hair and shoulders, and a sheer white curtain drifts slowly in the breeze behind them. In the first second, <Subject 2> slowly raises his right hand and curves his fingers gently around the back of <Subject 1>'s neck, his thumb brushing the soft skin below her ear. On the second beat, he leans in, his eyelids lowering, and their lips meet softly. <Subject 1>'s eyes flutter shut, her lashes barely visible behind her glasses. For the next two seconds they hold the kiss, her face relaxed, his hand warm and steady at the nape of her neck; her round glasses slide a fraction down her nose with the motion. In the final second, <Subject 1> lifts her left hand to curl around the back of <Subject 2>'s neck, and his hand slides down from her neck to rest at her waist, pulling her gently closer. The golden light shifts slowly across their faces, the sheer curtain billows once more in the background, and a few strands of her black hair stir in the warm draft. The camera performs an almost imperceptible slow push-in, never cutting, staying on the close-up of their faces through the whole five seconds.
